The '''G'rho Defense Force''' was the militia on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[G'rho]]. Its members included the [[Ilwizzt]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Brco]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Jerriman]], [[Historian/Legends|military historian]] [[Ydra Kilwallen Sibwarra|Ydra Sibwarra]], and [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] [[Trig Kilwallen|Trig]] and [[Seni Kilwallen|Seni]]. The militia included a number of [[Conjo fighter]]s.

In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], [[G'rho]] was [[Battle of G'rho|raided]] by the [[Ssi-ruu]]. The Defense Force tried to hold back the attackers but were unsuccessful. Virtually all the planet's colonists were subsequently killed by the Ssi-ruu.
